anchors.claim: A detector is VALID only when the pair (fires, silent) holds; fires-in-both is a false-positive machine and silent-in-both is decorative.

both_states_rule.canonical: A detector, gate, validator or probe is VALID only when it FIRES on a known-broken (bad) input AND stays SILENT on a known-good input. Silent-in-both-states measures nothing. Fires-in-both-states is a false-positive machine.
both_states_rule.reconstruction_reason: The named input rules/common/single-signal-verification.md is missing. Reconstruction uses three local anchors that all state the fire-on-bad AND silent-on-good pair.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A negative control is a second variable (outcome N or exposure B) chosen to be U-comparable with the primary pair (A,Y) while A does not cause N (or B does not cause Y). An association on the control pair, analysed the same way as A-Y, detects residual unmeasured confounding rather than validating a detector on labelled fixtures.
claims.strongest_caveat: U-comparability is approximate. Lipsitch states a non-null A-N does not prove A-Y is biased, and a null A-N does not prove A-Y is unconfounded, if the unobserved common-cause sets differ.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A physics null test reports a residual on a designed-zero observable as a numeric bound with separate statistical and systematic errors, plus a same-composition control instrument that must also be null.
claims.strongest_caveat: Transferring a 10^-15 Eotvos bound into software is analogical: the NEW content is the quantitative residual, not the gravity result itself. A binary SUREF 'compatible with null' reading alone would restate silent-on-good.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A placebo/sham arm matches expectancy, attention, ritual and assessment while omitting the putative pharmacologic (or physical) mechanism, so the contrast isolates that mechanism from the rest of the treatment package.
claims.strongest_caveat: Hrobjartsson warn against pooling (I2 42%, funnel asymmetry). Pain effect is heterogeneous; four overlapping acupuncture trials SMD -0.68 vs three other pain trials SMD -0.13 (-0.28 to 0.03). Observer-reported SMD -0.13 is small. Software has no patient expectancy, so the analog is only for human-in-the-loop probes.

mechanisms.not_already_in_rule: The freeze-before-unblind discipline (hidden signal box, hidden offset) is not stated by both-states. Known-broken fixtures are the overlapping part and are restated; the temporal freeze is the increment. Experimenter's bias size cannot be estimated, only prevented.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Klein & Roodman, Annu. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 2005;55:141-163, Section 2 numerical example of statistical cut bias; Section 3.1 Hidden Signal Box
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: Klein & Roodman note the hidden box is inappropriate when signal events themselves must be used to measure efficiency. The 3-sigma worked example is a cartoon of cut bias, not a measured PDG pull. PARTIAL because the known-broken fixture half of the practice already sits in the estate rule.

mechanisms.baseline: E10 definition: ability to distinguish effective from less effective or ineffective treatment. Jackson causal-null RR = 1.0 in the pre-season window. An analysis that looks protective on that window has failed the discrimination the guideline names.
mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: ICH E10 assay sensitivity is the ability of a trial to distinguish an effective treatment from a less effective or ineffective one. This restates both-states discrimination. Null result for THIS unit.
mechanisms.effect_size: Definitional in E10; empirical analog is Jackson pre-season RR 0.39 (95% CI 0.33-0.47) which 'distinguishes' vaccinated from unvaccinated when the treatment cannot work.
mechanisms.not_already_in_rule: Nothing new: assay sensitivity is the same pair as fire-on-effective / silent-on-ineffective. This is a null result, a restatement of both-states, not an addition to the rule.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: ICH E10 (CPMP/ICH/364/96) sections 1.5 and 1.5.2 Assay Sensitivity (guideline PDF has no DOI; numeric analog Jackson et al. IJE 2006 Results)
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: E10's non-inferiority discussion (historical evidence of sensitivity to drug effects) is about borrowing past placebo gaps, which is a different operationalisation, but the CORE definition in 1.5 is the discrimination test.

mechanisms.baseline: Expected null: same bacterial counts with/without cytokine in the absence of neutrophils; RR=1.0 for influenza vaccine on injury/trauma or on death before influenza circulates.
mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: Experimental biology repeats the assay under conditions expected to produce a null (leave out an essential ingredient; inactivate the active ingredient) and requires that the null appear. Null result relative to silent-on-good.
mechanisms.effect_size: Qualitative protocol, numeric illustration via Jackson: injury/trauma hospitalization as 'impossible-by-mechanism' control, paired with pre-season mortality RR 0.39 vs causal-null 1.0.
mechanisms.not_already_in_rule: Leave-out-an-essential-ingredient restates silent-on-good: the assay must not fire when the hypothesized mechanism is removed. Reported as a null result, not novelty.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Lipsitch et al. 2010, section 'Experimental biology: threats to causal inference and the use of negative controls' (leave-out / inactivate / impossible-by-mechanism list)
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: The SAME paper's U-comparable construction (M-U-COMPARABLE) is new; only the laboratory 'verify the null appears' half is a restatement.

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: Reading MICROSCOPE SUREF solely as 'compatible with a null result' without the numeric bound restates silent-on-good. Null result.
mechanisms.effect_size: SUREF delta(Pt,Pt) = [+4 +/- 4(stat)] x 10^-15, described as fully compatible with a null result.
mechanisms.not_already_in_rule: A same-composition control that must look null is silent-on-good for the instrument. That binary reading restates both-states. The numeric 10^-15 bound is carved out as M-QUANT-NULL instead of being dressed into this row.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Touboul et al. 2017, text after Eq. (3) (SUREF null compatibility)
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: The paper reports the number and the compatibility sentence together; splitting them is an analytic choice of THIS unit so the restatement is not smuggled into the NEW row.

mechanisms.canonical_mechanism: A double negative control (NCE + NCO) can nonparametrically identify the average treatment effect under completeness conditions. Not promoted: no effect size AND baseline in the review body used here.
mechanisms.not_already_in_rule: Identification of an ATE is not a detector test, so it would be new IF a headline number with baseline were attached. Catalog forbids promoting a mechanism from a headline without baseline; this row is E3 and is not in the NEW list.
mechanisms.section_or_figure: Shi, Miao, Tchetgen Tchetgen, arXiv:2009.05641, section 'Nonparametric identification in a double negative control design'
mechanisms.strongest_caveat: The identification claim is real in the literature (Miao/Shi/Tchetgen line) but THIS unit did not extract a numeric ATE versus a named baseline from the review, so it stays NOT-CHECKED.

new_versus_restated.how_to_read: NEW = practice the both-states pair does not already require. RESTATED-NULL = agrees with the existing rule; reported as a null result, not dressed as novelty. E3-NOT-PROMOTED = headline without baseline, cannot promote a mechanism.

null_result_statement: Honest null result: ICH E10 assay sensitivity, laboratory leave-out-ingredient null repeats, and a binary reading of the MICROSCOPE SUREF same-composition control restate the estate both-states pair (fire on the broken state, silent on the good state). Those rows are restated_null_results. They are not promoted as additions to the rule.
question: How do clinical trials and experimental physics define and validate a negative control, and what does their practice add to this estate's both-states rule that the rule does not already say?

title: Extract negative-control practice from disciplines where it is mandatory
